facts.fact: The case study says NITA-U reported in 2023 that the National Backbone Infrastructure, over 4,000 km, had a current reach of 53 of the 146 districts and 61 local government sites; no total of local government sites is given.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure and e-Government Infrastructure Project (NBI/EGI)

facts.fact: The case study, citing the 2022 National ICT Survey, says fewer than 5% of district government staff had a computer for work and only 2.5% of district staff had internet access; these are shares of staff, not of local governments.
facts.system: district local government offices (no system named)

facts.fact: The case study says the backbone and e-Government network project is implemented by the state agency NITA-U, with Huawei Technologies, and that NITA-U reported its reach in 2023.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure and e-Government Infrastructure Project (NBI/EGI)

facts.fact: The case study says the government took a USD 100 million loan from the EXIM Bank of China in 2006 for the backbone and e-Government infrastructure project, and that an IDA credit of up to USD 85 million (RCIP) followed in 2016 and closed in August 2022.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure and e-Government Infrastructure Project (NBI/EGI)

systems.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure and e-Government Infrastructure Project (NBI/EGI)
systems.platform: optic fibre backbone; Huawei Technologies as implementer
systems.tiers: Ministries and departments; 53 of 146 districts and 61 local government sites (2023)

systems.platform: WSO2, open source, hosted in the government data centre
systems.tiers: 113 entities onboarded, 47 of them ministries, departments and agencies; no local government named as a participant

systems.owner: Government of Uganda; World Bank loan of about USD 200 million
systems.tiers: Stated purpose: upgrade the data exchange platform to onboard more agencies
